scope: Installed dpkg binary packages in final linux/amd64 Debian or Ubuntu image filesystem
association: Both scanners read the same immutable archive bytes; capture SHA256 before and after each process; compare config/image ID, platform and archive SHA256 receipts. Image manifest and index identities remain separate.
value: Exact full installed version, including epoch and Debian revision; never strip suffixes
purl: Decode percent escapes only. Retain every qualifier. Require deb namespace/name/version/arch agreement with native fields. Distro codename qualifiers are retained separately from numeric OS version. Source/upstream qualifier is provenance, not binary identity.
duplicates: Identical and contradictory duplicate keys are ERROR; preserve pointers; never collapse using a set
missing: Missing identity, unexpected empty inventory or ambiguous identity is ERROR
difference: MISMATCH is a concrete difference in scoped inventories, not proof of producer omission or completeness. Unresolved modeling differences prevent adoption.
exclusions: Non-dpkg families and file integrity, runtime completeness, CVEs, authenticity and admission are NOT_EVALUATED. Syft only selects dpkg-db-cataloger, never an SBOM cataloger.
adoption: Separate GO scoped to demonstrated properties, NO_GO or INCONCLUSIVE; harness detecting a negative never means the mutated SBOM passes
